headline: Committee discussed fire and police reports and city camera usage with no action taken
summary: The committee heard an oral report from Fire Chief Curtin on August responses and from Police Chief Burke on August incident data. Chief Innovation Officer Scot Barker discussed the city's camera systems and their use. No action was taken on any of these items.
